LESSON: EATING HABITS

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.2: Eating habits

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Eating habits
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: what family foods their family members and members and friends?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Eating habits
2. give Kenyan examples of Eating habits
3. practise a safe skill for Eating habits

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Eating habits

Teach
• Observe Eating habits in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Eating habits (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Eating habits.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Eating habits.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Eating habits.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Eating habits.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Eating habits: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. what family foods their family members and members and friends?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Eating habits with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
